result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to cut-off elements at the screen edges and truncated text.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its image and text partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll indication is clear or adjust card sizing so partial cards clearly indicate scrollability without abruptly cutting off text.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated (possibly missing letters) at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Truncate text properly with ellipsis or ensure full name is visible within the card boundary.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to have an additional category cut off at the right edge of the screen, suggesting horizontal scrolling isn't clearly indicated.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient effect at the edge to indicate more scrollable content, or add a peek of the next category for better affordance.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card is abruptly cut off at the bottom of the screen without any visible text or restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure content sections have proper spacing/padding so cards aren't awkwardly cut off, or add a 'scroll for more' visual cue.

issues.description: Heart/favorite icon on the pizza promo card has low contrast against a similar dark overlay background, making it hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of the icon or add a distinct background circle to improve visibility.
